name: starci
description: StarCi: kernel-agent workflow runtime — one long-lived kernel agent per workflow, one ephemeral op agent per job, a sqlite ledger as the only state.

scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const cp=require('child_process');let bad=0,n=0;const walk=d=>{let ents;try{ents=fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})}catch{return}for(const e of ents){if(e.name==='node_modules')continue;const p=d+'/'+e.name;if(e.isDirectory())walk(p);else if(e.name.endsWith('.mjs')){n++;const r=cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,['--check',p],{encoding:'utf8'});if(r.status!==0){bad++;process.stderr.write(p+'\n'+(r.stderr||'')+'\n')}}}};for(const d of ['engine','scripts','modules','bin'])walk(d);console.log('node --check: '+n+' files, '+bad+' failed');if(bad)process.exit(1)" && node scripts/route/build-ops-registry.mjs --check && node scripts/checks/providers.mjs && node scripts/checks/check-api-surface.mjs && node scripts/checks/check-contract-cites.mjs && node scripts/checks/check-schema-catalog.mjs && node scripts/checks/check-host-boundary.mjs && node scripts/checks/check-module-yaml.mjs && node scripts/checks/check-op-manifest.mjs && node scripts/checks/grammar-dist.mjs
